all.what_alpha_scales: every calibrated instruction error (gates, readout, reset); durations and T1/T2 as calibrated

2q.what_alpha_scales: only the '2q' errors (dgssp.backends.error_class); every other error, durations and T1/T2 as calibrated

readout.what_alpha_scales: only the 'readout' errors (dgssp.backends.error_class); every other error, durations and T1/T2 as calibrated

depth.pooling: each record's lambda = 1 PUB and its drift copy (same circuit) are fitted together: one alpha_r per distinct circuit and day
depth.exclusion_rule: r > r_opt (over-rotated: past r_opt noise can raise P(solution), so P(alpha) and kept are not a survival); alpha_r at the grid edge; non-monotone model curve; the day-2 failure record

excluded_because: day-2 out-of-sample failure (at random on every circuit)

residuals.sigma: sqrt(var_hw + var_model), Jeffreys-smoothed binomial at the job's shots (the alpha fit's weights)

day_to_day.note: each day's alpha_r is relative to that day's execution calibration; the layouts differ; shots 4096 (day 1) and 12288 (day 2)

excluded_because: day-2 out-of-sample failure (at random on every circuit)

layered.definition: EPLG = 1 - LF**(1/(N-1)) for the longest chain N reported (lf_<N> in BackendProperties.general, chain in general_qlists); a process infidelity per layered gate, single-qubit gates and crosstalk included
